possible_risks.description: Lack of model transparency is due to insufficient documentation of the model design, development, and evaluation process and the absence of insights into the inner workings of the model.
possible_risks.justification: Card reports only architecture, merge method, and merged checkpoints, with no training data, evaluation, or intended-use details for this exact checkpoint.

possible_risks.description: Since foundation models can be used for many purposes, a model's intended use is important for defining the relevant risks of that model. As the use changes, the relevant risks might correspondingly change.
possible_risks.justification: Card gives no intended-use or deployment context for this mental-health-related merge, so downstream uses and relevant risks are undefined.

possible_risks.description: Proper documentation contains information about how a model's data was collected, curated, and used to train a model, including any synthetic data generation processes. Without proper documentation it might be harder to satisfactorily explain the behavior of the model.
possible_risks.justification: Card does not describe the data used to train or fine-tune the merged checkpoints, leaving collection and curation undocumented.

possible_risks.description: Data provenance refers to the traceability of data (including synthetic data), which includes its ownership, origin, transformations, and generation. Proving that the data is the same as the original source with correct usage terms is difficult without standardized methods for verifying data sources or generation.
possible_risks.justification: Card names the merged checkpoints but does not document the provenance, ownership, or usage terms of their underlying training data.

possible_risks.description: Hallucinations generate factually inaccurate or untruthful content relative to the model's training data or input. Hallucinations are also sometimes referred to lack of faithfulness or lack of groundedness. In some instances, synthetic data that is generated by large language models might include hallucinations that result in the data possibly being inaccurate, fabricated, or disconnected from reality. Hallucinations can compromise model performance, accuracy, and relevance.
possible_risks.justification: A mental-health text model with no reported evaluation or safeguards can plausibly generate ungrounded or factually inaccurate advice.

specifications.model_size: 18.9 GiB of safetensors weights (20,318,474,544 bytes) in BF16

training_context.adaptations: This model is a merge of two Gemma-2-9B based checkpoints using the SLERP merge method. The merged checkpoints are recoilme/recoilme-gemma-2-9B-v0.4 and ehristoforu/Gemma2-9B-it-psy10k-mental_health.
